title: What your client does with an estimate

steps.caption: Estimates
steps.narration: Send an estimate, and your client gets a link by email. Here is what they do with it.

steps.caption: Open the estimate
steps.narration: Open the estimate. This draft is for Imani Brewster, in Dallas.

steps.caption: Sent, not opened yet
steps.narration: It is emailed to her. This line says when, and that it is not opened yet.

steps.caption: The client opens the emailed link
steps.narration: Now your client. She opens the link in that email.

steps.caption: The estimate as a document
steps.narration: Your estimate opens as a document, with your company details and the total on top.

steps.caption: Prepared for
steps.narration: It is made out to her, with the job address.

steps.caption: The lines
steps.narration: Each line shows the quantity, the price and the line total.

steps.caption: Subtotal, tax, total
steps.narration: Under the lines are the subtotal, the tax on this estimate, and the total.

steps.caption: Her full name
steps.narration: To approve, she types her full name. That is her signature.

steps.caption: Approve this estimate
steps.narration: Then she chooses Approve this estimate.

steps.caption: Approved
steps.narration: The page thanks her, and says you have been notified.

steps.caption: Pay
steps.narration: With online payments connected, she can pay from the same page.

steps.caption: Back in the CRM
steps.narration: Back in your CRM, open the same estimate.

steps.selector: xpath=//*[contains(normalize-space(.),"Approved by Imani Brewster") and not(*[contains(normalize-space(.),"Approved by Imani Brewster")])]/ancestor::div[contains(@class,"rounded")][1]
steps.caption: A signed contract
steps.narration: It was approved in her name, and it is now a signed contract.

steps.caption: Opened
steps.narration: This line shows when she opened it.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: You will find every estimate under Estimates, in the left menu.

youtube.title: What your client sees when you send an estimate | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: Send an estimate from ConstructHUB CRM, then follow it to the client's side: the emailed link, the estimate laid out as a document, and approving by typing a name. Then see the approval land back in your CRM. The walkthrough uses a demo company and demo clients.
